title: descurainia incana var. viscosa
intro: Descurainia incana var. viscosa, commonly known as Sticky Tansy or Sticky Wild Cress, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Descurainia incana var. viscosa include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as saponins, flavonoids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions, but it has been traditionally used to relieve congestion and coughs.
